18: std::string normalize_word(std::string_view word) {
19:     std::string normalized;
20:     normalized.reserve(word.size());
21: 
22:     for (unsigned char ch : word) {
23:         if (std::isalnum(ch) != 0) {
24:             normalized.push_back(static_cast<char>(std::tolower(ch)));
25:         }
26:     }
27: 
28:     return normalized;
29: }

31: std::vector<std::string> tokenize(std::string_view text) {
32:     std::vector<std::string> words;
33:     std::istringstream stream{std::string{text}};
34: 
35:     for (std::string raw_word; stream >> raw_word;) {
36:         std::string word = normalize_word(raw_word);
37:         if (!word.empty()) {
38:             words.push_back(std::move(word));
39:         }
40:     }
41: 
42:     return words;
43: }

49: bool is_blank_line(std::string_view line) {

64: void append_lines(std::string& text, const std::vector<std::string>& lines, LineRange range) {
65:     for (size_t line = range.begin; line < range.end; ++line) {
66:         if (!text.empty()) {
67:             text.push_back('\n');

79: std::string normalize_file_path(std::string_view path) {
80:     const std::filesystem::path file_path{path};
81: 
82:     std::error_code error;
83:     const std::filesystem::path canonical_path =
84:         std::filesystem::weakly_canonical(file_path, error);
85:     if (!error) {
86:         return canonical_path.string();
87:     }
88: 
89:     const std::filesystem::path absolute_path = std::filesystem::absolute(file_path, error);
90:     if (!error) {
91:         return absolute_path.lexically_normal().string();
92:     }

103: Result<std::vector<std::string>> SearchEngine::list_book_files(std::string_view dir) const {
104:     const std::filesystem::path directory{dir};
105:     std::error_code error;
106: 
107:     if (!std::filesystem::is_directory(directory, error) || error) {
108:         return std::unexpected(make_err(ErrCode::FileOpenFailed, error.value()));
109:     }
110: 
111:     std::vector<std::filesystem::path> book_paths;
112:     for (const std::filesystem::directory_entry& entry :
113:         std::filesystem::directory_iterator{directory, error}) {
114:         if (error) {
115:             return std::unexpected(make_err(ErrCode::FileOpenFailed, error.value()));
116:         }
117: 
118:         std::error_code entry_error;
119:         if (entry.is_regular_file(entry_error) && entry.path().extension() == ".txt") {
120:             book_paths.push_back(entry.path());
121:         }
122:     }
123: 
124:     if (error) {
125:         return std::unexpected(make_err(ErrCode::FileOpenFailed, error.value()));
126:     }
127: 
128:     std::ranges::sort(
129:         book_paths, {}, [](const std::filesystem::path& path) { return path.string(); });
130: 
131:     std::vector<std::string> files;
132:     files.reserve(book_paths.size());
133:     for (const std::filesystem::path& path : book_paths) {
134:         files.push_back(path.string());
135:     }
136: 
137:     return files;
138: }

140: Result<size_t> SearchEngine::load_file(std::string_view path) {
141:     const std::string normalized_path = normalize_file_path(path);
142:     if (loaded_file_paths.contains(normalized_path)) {
143:         return 0;
144:     }
145: 
146:     Result<Book> book = Book::create(path);
147:     if (!book) {
148:         return std::unexpected(book.error());
149:     }
150:

152:     loaded_file_paths.insert(std::move(normalized_path));
153:     return 1;

156: void SearchEngine::add_book(Book book) {
157:     const size_t book_id = books.size();
158: 
159:     for (size_t line_id = 0; line_id < book.lines.size(); ++line_id) {
160:         const std::vector<std::string> words = tokenize(book.lines[line_id]);
161:         for (size_t word_idx = 0; word_idx < words.size(); ++word_idx) {
162:             const std::string& word = words[word_idx];
163:             inverted_index[word].emplace_back(Index{
164:                 .book_id = book_id,
165:                 .line = line_id,
166:                 .word_idx = word_idx,
167:             });
168:             ++word_counts[word];
169:         }
170:     }
171: 
172:     books.push_back(std::move(book));
173: }

175: std::vector<Index> SearchEngine::search_with_context(const SearchRequest& request) const {
176:     std::vector<Index> matches;
177: 
178:     switch (request.mode) {
179:         case SearchMode::Or:
180:             matches = search_or(request.query);
181:             break;
182:         case SearchMode::And:
183:             matches = search_and(request.query);
184:             break;
185:         case SearchMode::Phrase:
186:             matches = search_phrase(request.query);
187:             break;
188:         case SearchMode::Not:
189:             matches = search_not(request.query);
190:             break;
191:         case SearchMode::Near:
192:             matches = search_near(request.query, request.near_distance);
193:             break;
194:     }
195: 
196:     std::vector<Index> hits;
197:     hits.reserve(matches.size());
198: 
199:     for (const Index& index : matches) {
200:         if (index.book_id >= books.size()) {
201:             continue;
202:         }
203: 
204:         hits.push_back(index);
205:     }
206: 
207:     return hits;
208: }

212: std::vector<Index> SearchEngine::search_or(std::string_view query) const {
213:     std::vector<Index> matches;
214: 
215:     for (const std::string& word : tokenize(query)) {
216:         const auto found = inverted_index.find(word);
217:         if (found != inverted_index.end()) {
218:             matches.insert(matches.end(), found->second.begin(), found->second.end());
219:         }
220:     }
221: 
222:     std::ranges::sort(matches, {}, cmpr);
223: 
224:     return matches;
225: }

227: std::vector<Index> SearchEngine::search_and(std::string_view query) const {
228:     std::vector<std::string> words;
229:     std::unordered_set<std::string> seen_words;
230: 
231:     for (std::string& word : tokenize(query)) {
232:         if (seen_words.insert(word).second) {
233:             words.emplace_back(std::move(word));
234:         }
235:     }
236: 
237:     if (words.empty()) {
238:         return {};
239:     }
240: 
241:     std::unordered_map<size_t, size_t> book_match_counts;
242: 
243:     for (const std::string& word : words) {
244:         const auto found = inverted_index.find(word);
245:         if (found == inverted_index.end()) {
246:             return {};
247:         }
248: 
249:         std::unordered_set<size_t> matched_books;
250:         for (const Index& index : found->second) {
251:             matched_books.emplace(index.book_id);
252:         }
253: 
254:         for (size_t book_id : matched_books) {
255:             book_match_counts[book_id]++;
256:         }
257:     }
258: 
259:     std::unordered_set<size_t> matched_books;
260:     for (const auto& [book_id, count] : book_match_counts) {
261:         if (count == words.size()) {
262:             matched_books.insert(book_id);
263:         }
264:     }
265: 
266:     if (matched_books.empty()) {
267:         return {};
268:     }
269: 
270:     std::vector<Index> matches;
271:     for (const std::string& word : words) {
272:         const auto& indices = inverted_index.at(word);
273: 
274:         for (const Index& index : indices) {
275:             if (matched_books.contains(index.book_id)) {
276:                 matches.push_back(index);
277:             }
278:         }
279:     }
280: 
281:     std::ranges::sort(matches, {}, cmpr);
282: 
283:     return matches;
284: }
285: 
286: std::vector<Index> SearchEngine::search_phrase(std::string_view query) const {
287:     const std::vector<std::string> words = tokenize(query);
288:     if (words.empty()) {
289:         return {};
290:     }
291: 
292:     const auto first_word = inverted_index.find(words.front());
293:     if (first_word == inverted_index.end()) {
294:         return {};
295:     }
296: 
297:     std::vector<Index> matches;
298:     for (const Index& start : first_word->second) {
299:         std::vector<Index> phrase_match{start};
300:         bool is_phrase = true;
301: 
302:         for (size_t offset = 1; offset < words.size(); ++offset) {
303:             const auto found = inverted_index.find(words[offset]);
304:             if (found == inverted_index.end()) {
305:                 return {};
306:             }
307: 
308:             const auto next = std::ranges::find_if(found->second, [&](const Index& index) {
309:                 return index.book_id == start.book_id && index.line == start.line &&
310:                        index.word_idx == start.word_idx + offset;
311:             });
312: 
313:             if (next == found->second.end()) {
314:                 is_phrase = false;
315:                 break;
316:             }
317: 
318:             phrase_match.push_back(*next);
319:         }
320: 
321:         if (is_phrase) {
322:             matches.insert(matches.end(), phrase_match.begin(), phrase_match.end());
323:         }
324:     }
325: 
326:     std::ranges::sort(matches, {}, cmpr);
327:     return matches;
328: }
